newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dah Sing says in JV with Hambros, Abbey.
newsitem.headline: Dah Sing says in JV with Hambros, Abbey.

text.p: Dah Sing Financial Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it, Hambros Plc unit Hambros Bank Ltd and Abbey National Plc had agreed in principle to form a joint venture international private banking operation.

Abbey National and Hambros participation would be split into 6.3 percent voting and 18.2 percent non-voting rights, it said. That would give Dah Sing 80.2 percent of the voting rights with Abbey National and Hambros each having 9.9 percent.
Abbey National and Hambros would each invest about HK$85 million, dependent on net asset value at completion, the statement said.
The joint venture bank in Hong Kong would offer private banking services and investment advice, it said.
The Channel Islands bank, to be managed by Hambros, would offer complementary banking services to such clients.
The pact was subject to regulatory approvals and completion of satisfactory due diligence, Dah Sing said.
Officials from Hambros and Abbey National were not immediately available for comment.
